why: A language note printed on a line with no text of its own ("(In English):" in 22130 and 23229) introduces the speaker's next paragraph, so the note moves to that row. When the next row is another speaker's or has no speaker, as the italic subheading "Helping SMEs" in 23229, the note is kept nowhere.
title: DEBATE ON ANNUAL BUDGET STATEMENT
html:
Sitting Date:03-02-2009
Title:DEBATE ON ANNUAL BUDGET STATEMENT


Column: 1

DEBATE ON ANNUAL BUDGET STATEMENT

Mrs Josephine Teo: Only then can Singapore be the most pro-worker nation in the world.

     (In English):

 

     Not only will workers do their part to tilt the balance in their own favour, we call on business leaders to do their part.

Ms Lee Bee Wah: As an added measure, I would like to suggest to the Government to set up a not-for-profit institute of education.

    (In English):

 

Helping SMEs

 

     Sir, next, I will move on to the internationalisation of local businesses.
